product.name: PRODUCT/SERVICE
product.offer: What you are selling and the core promise
product.cta: Link in bio / Shop now / DM the word ...
product._note: Drop product photos/clips/logo in product_assets/ — the engine overlays them on B-roll and avatar shots.

avatar._note: The 'creator' face that reviews/recommends the product. Lock ONE reference image so the persona stays consistent across every ad.

style_rules: Conversational, like a real customer talking to camera — not an announcer
Open with the problem, not the product
One clear CTA at the end
Short sentences. Energy up, but believable.

pillars.name: HOOK_TEST
pillars.tone: 5 different 3-second hooks for the same product (test which wins)

pillars.name: PROBLEM
pillars.tone: relatable pain-point story, product as the fix

pillars.name: DEMO
pillars.tone: show the product working, screen/hand B-roll

brand_voice.tone: Authentic creator review. Warm, honest, a little excited.
openers: Okay I need to talk about this...
brand_voice.thesis: It should feel like a friend's recommendation, not a commercial.
